palette.mood: Deep marine indigo with phosphor chartreuse energy, pearl paper and warm sunrise coral process marks. Curious and hopeful without pretending the proposal is built.
palette.divergence: Unlike September 3rd's sunlit sage care room and September 1st's aubergine cosmic machinery, this film lives in a dark cutaway sea with bright chartreuse current paths, hexagonal pods and a hard white federal-paper reveal.

light.time: Subsea blue hour under a bright paper-world top light
light.direction: Upper-right pearl shaft, low blue fill, chartreuse rim on energized proposal lines and coral rim on gates
light.depth: Three water strata frame shadowless proposed turbines, hives, cable routes and energy pulses. Only the physical reel, steel test bench, FERC paper, stamp, rope and calendar receive contact shadows. Foreground paper and silt live at z 170 for parallax.

shape_language.grammar: Rounded turbine circles and cable coils express physical flow. Hexagonal hives express compact compute. Rectangular federal paper and square locks express institutional proof. Dashed, unfilled proposal geometry is a fourth grammar and never gains physical contact.
shape_language.why: The story moves from a compatible circle-and-hex machine into the harder rectilinear evidence gates.

inventory.subject: Armored hybrid power and fiber cable

casting.net_new: SubseaHive, HydrokineticTurbine and ArmoredCable silhouettes in video-engine/src/lib/subsea.tsx. Existing EvidenceState, Simulated, PendingMark and Sheet carry proposal and permit status.
casting.continuity: Use existing Sheet, EvidenceState, Simulated, PendingMark, Character hands, lighting and Stage3D primitives. Build no second evidence-status system. All infrastructure is shadowless and explicitly PROPOSED from frame one.

motion_language.grammar: Current lines coil and settle like underwater cable. Proposal objects assemble with elastic overshoot. The federal notice lands with weight, then the build fantasy drains to dashed outlines.
hero_moves: An exhausted export cable snaps short before a hive descends
One cable splits visibly toward primary compute and conditional spare-grid branches
The entire underwater array folds into a paper permit ticket
Four proof locks stop the plug one inch from the Alaska-value socket and remain closed through the button
motion_language.blur: Directional blur only on the opening snap, array multiplication and paper drop. Proof locks use crisp anticipation and damped impact. The final cable emits a suspended hum and never clicks through.

composition.staging: Four authored worlds: macro plug, vertical seafloor cutaway, split routing bench and federal-paper test chamber. Alternate macro, wide, overhead and extreme-wide across 14 shots.
composition.safe_area: Critical mechanisms and labels stay within x120 to 960 and y450 to 1260. Wide array, routing, test, paper, clock and button shots each carry explicit square_safe bounds in storyboard.json. Caption band begins at y1336.
composition.signature_shot: Pull back from one glowing hive to 66 dashed pods among hundreds of rotor marks. A white FERC sheet then folds the entire array into a tiny STUDY PRIORITY ticket while an excavator brakes behind NO CONSTRUCTION.
composition.focal_hierarchy: One acting object per beat. Chartreuse is proposed physical flow, coral is unresolved condition, white is source status. No full-frame UI dashboards.
composition.attribution: PROPOSED persists across all hardware. FERC source/date appears on the paper reveal. Environmental questions remain labeled QUESTIONS, never impacts.
